summary: Diff adds a new Motoko backend actor and a new React frontend implementing authenticated gating, client-side AES-GCM encryption with PBKDF2-derived keys, and React Query-based queries/mutations for events/tasks. However, several requested CRUD/edit and calendar viewing requirements are not clearly implemented (notably update flows and month/week calendar view), and the backend introduces extra user-profile/admin access-control features not requested.

missing_requirements.requirement: Backend CRUD endpoints to store, list, update, and delete encrypted events and tasks per authenticated user (separately supporting 'event' and 'task' types), with access control enforced by caller identity.
missing_requirements.reason: The backend file is truncated and only shows addEvent/addTask and profile methods; required list/update/delete methods for both events and tasks are not evidenced. Frontend calls actor.getEvents/getTasks/deleteEvent/deleteTask/updateTaskStatus, but their backend implementations are not visible in the provided diff summary.

missing_requirements.requirement: UI supports (1) viewing a minimal month/week list of events, (2) a task list view, and (3) lightweight create/edit forms for events and tasks; users can add/edit/delete events and tasks.
missing_requirements.reason: Tasks view/list appears implemented, and create/delete flows exist, but event viewing is a card grid rather than a month/week list. Also, edit flows appear not implemented correctly: EventFormDialog/TaskFormDialog use useAddEvent/useAddTask even when an existing item is passed, with no update mutation/hooks shown for editing event/task content.

missing_requirements.requirement: Define and apply a coherent visual theme across screens; primary styling must not use a blue/purple dominant palette.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows use of theme variables/classes (e.g., bg-primary/10, text-primary) but does not provide the actual color palette/theme definitions, so compliance with the 'no blue/purple dominant palette' constraint cannot be verified from the provided changes.

hallucinated_features.description: User profile creation/setup flow (name) required before accessing the app.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest did not require user profiles; it required Internet Identity auth + passphrase unlock for encrypted content, but not collecting/storing a profile name.

hallucinated_features.description: Admin/role-based access control initialization via secret token and authorization mixins.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only required per-caller access control for calendar items; it did not request an admin system or secret-token initialization.

hallucinated_features.description: Marketing/security claims in UI copy (e.g., 'military-grade encryption', explicitly 'AES-256-GCM').
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested; requirement only specified use of Web Crypto PBKDF2 + AES-GCM (example) and client-side encryption behavior, not marketing language.
Not requested in UI requirements; may be extraneous to the compact productivity app scope.
